import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen, verify, brute, controller
from fractions import Fraction

def tcase(rng):
    """Corner-case heavy epoch."""
    S = rng.randint(1,4)
    mode = rng.randrange(8)
    times = sorted(rng.sample(range(0,60), S))
    q = 0 if mode==1 else rng.randint(0,3)
    slots = [[times[i], q, 0 if i==0 else rng.randint(0,2)] for i in range(S)]
    B = 0 if mode==2 else rng.randint(1,4)
    I = 0 if mode==2 else rng.randint(0,B)
    G = rng.randint(0,3)
    groups=[]
    for g in range(G):
        p = -1 if (g==0 or rng.random()<.5) else rng.randint(0,g-1)
        groups.append([p, 0 if mode==3 else rng.randint(0,4)])
    F = rng.randint(1,3)
    flows=[]
    for f in range(F):
        tg = rng.randint(1,3)
        gp = -1 if (not groups or rng.random()<.3) else rng.randint(0,G-1)
        flows.append([tg, tg if mode==4 else rng.randint(tg,4), gp, rng.randint(0,6)])
    J = 0 if mode==5 else rng.randint(0,7)
    windows=[]
    for j in range(J):
        f = rng.randint(0,F-1)
        if mode==6:
            t = times[rng.randrange(S)]
            ready = t; exp = t
        else:
            ready = rng.randint(0,60); exp = ready + rng.randint(0,40)
        windows.append([f, ready, exp, rng.randint(1,65535), rng.randint(1,320),
                        0 if mode==7 else rng.randint(0,65535), rng.randint(1,50),
                        [[rng.randint(0,1500),rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)]])
    return {'model':rng.choice(['cnn','rnn']),'class_values':[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],
            'stats':[rng.randint(1,400) for _ in range(3)],'bucket':[B,I],'slots':slots,
            'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':windows}

def main():
    n=int(sys.argv[1]); s0=int(sys.argv[2]); bad=0; ncases=0
    t0=time.time()
    for i in range(n):
        rng=random.Random(s0+i)
        k = rng.randint(1,3)
        cases=[tcase(rng) for _ in range(k)]
        req={'version':3,'cases':cases}
        try:
            resp=controller.run(json.dumps(req).encode())
            verify.check_request(req,resp)
            for c,r in zip(cases,resp['results']):
                ncases+=1
                if len(c['windows'])<=6 and len(c['slots'])<=3:
                    preds = controller._predict(c['model'], c['windows'], c['flows'])
                    br = brute.best(c, preds)
                    got=(Fraction(r['ratio'][0],r['ratio'][1]), r['utility'], r['age'])
                    if got != br:
                        raise Exception('objective %s vs %s' % (got, br))
        except Exception as e:
            bad+=1
            print('FAIL', s0+i, type(e).__name__, str(e)[:220])
            if bad>6: break
    print('torture batches',n,'epochs',ncases,'bad',bad,'%.1fs'%(time.time()-t0))
main()
PYEOF
